title: Registrations Open: National Capacity Building Programme on Materiovigilance System in India
bodyHtml:
Enhance your knowledge and contribute to strengthening medical device safety and patient care through this national-level capacity building programme.

Organized by NIMHANS, Bengaluru and Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Medical College & Research Institute, Bengaluru, in collaboration with IPC under the Materiovigilance Programme of India (MvPI).

Who Should Attend?
👩‍⚕️ Healthcare Professionals
🔬 Biomedical Engineers
🎓 Researchers & Academicians
🏢 Industry Stakeholders
📚 Students
📅 Date: 10 July, 2026 (Friday)
📍 Venue: Platinum Jubilee Hall, NIMHANS, Bengaluru
🎯 Theme: Safeguarding Patients through Robust Medical Device Safety and Vigilance Systems
⏳ Registration Deadline: 30 June, 2026
Link to apply: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfN053UUn7x6FLTz0c6kzA98F0s0J-S4MlBVdvqtVO5KxsQVA/viewform (opens in a new tab)

Interested participants are encouraged to register and contribute towards strengthening medical device safety and patient safety initiatives in India.
